name: Sacred Line: Genesis
source:
16-bit extended version of Sacred Line in the form of Visual Novel / Quest Adventure game.
It tells the story of Ellen, a private detective, who is trying to survive in Eastern Europe. Lately detective business, which she inherited from her missing sister Sarah, almost ceased its existence and one day before she was going to close her office she got an anonymous call. The unknown asked her to find some hidden forest outpost and told her about its position. That was just the beginning.

[From [url=http://sashadarko.com/genesis.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
《Sacred Line》的16位元擴充版，以視覺小說與任務冒險遊戲的形式呈現。
故事講述了試圖在東歐生存下去的私家偵探艾倫。她從失蹤的姊姊莎拉那裡繼承了偵探業務，然而最近這份事業幾乎已經難以維持。就在她準備關閉事務所的前一天，一通匿名電話打了進來。陌生人要求她尋找一處隱蔽的森林前哨站，並告知了位置。而這，僅僅是個開始。

［摘自[url=http://sashadarko.com/genesis.html]官方網站[/url]］
